fields.name: employee_id
fields.reason: Columns Emp ID, staff_code, code, strEmployeeCode, emp_ref, emp_ref all contain the employee identifier

fields.name: first_name
fields.reason: Columns First Name, given_name, fname, strFirstNm, legal_first, First Name. all represent the employee's given name

fields.name: last_name
fields.reason: Columns Last Name, surname, lname, strLastNm, legal_last, Last Namé all represent the employee's family name

fields.name: work_email
fields.reason: Columns Email, strEmailAddr, email_id, corp_email, contact (when email) hold the employee's corporate email address

fields.name: mobile_phone
fields.reason: Columns Mobile, strMobileNo, cell, contact (when phone) contain the employee's mobile number

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.reason: Columns DOB, dtDateOfBirth, birth_date, birth_dt all store the employee's birth date

fields.name: date_of_joining
fields.reason: Columns Date of Joining, doj, dtDateOfJoin, joining_dt, hire_dt all capture the employee's start date

fields.name: department_code
fields.reason: Columns Dept Code, dept, strDeptCd, div_code represent the department identifier

fields.name: location_code
fields.reason: Columns Location, loc, office, site, strLocCd hold the office/location code

fields.name: job_title
fields.reason: Columns Designation, strDesignation, grade, job_title all describe the employee's role or title

fields.name: employment_type
fields.reason: Columns Employment Type, emp_type, strEmpType, worker_class, Employment capture the contract type

fields.name: manager_id
fields.reason: Columns Manager ID, mgr, reports_to, supervisor_ref, strReportingMgr, Type -Manager ID reference the employee's manager

fields.name: grade_band
fields.reason: Column strGradeBand stores the employee's grade band (e.g., B1, B2, C1)

fields.name: cost_centre
fields.reason: Column cost_centre holds the cost centre code for the employee

fields.name: is_active
fields.reason: Column is_active_flag indicates whether the employee is currently active

fields.name: is_deleted
fields.reason: Column bIsDeleted flags soft‑deletion of a record

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.reason: Columns intSeqNo, record_no provide a sequential identifier from the source system

fields.name: legacy_system_id
fields.reason: Column legacy_sys_id stores the identifier from the legacy HR system

fields.name: source_system
fields.reason: Column strSourceSystem indicates which source system the row originated from

fields.name: last_sync_timestamp
fields.reason: Column dtLastSync records when the record was last synchronized
